A self-financing luminaire replacement project was developed for the Municipality, an energy saving of 38% was achieved, equivalent to 7 million pesos per year. It was supported by a social communication campaign, which included a carbon neutral launching event and the recognition of environmental NGOs. This project included a campaign to replace domestic light bulbs, exchanging more than 30,000 traditional light bulbs for efficient ones.
